text: Dispatch queues taken whole: component run_post and mailbox run take their whole queue out, so a close of window A by an earlier item cannot cancel A's later items, which then run in another window's turn. Same class as the r17 timer finding, fixed for timers only. A repro is written but not yet run: run it first, and if it fails the fix is one shared cancel-by-window mechanism for all queues.

Closure-holding lint misses: generic field whose Fn bound sits only on the impl (confirmed with the lint's own visitor), closures behind allowlisted wrappers such as Callback in a Signal, AppHandle of dyn Fn, and user traits with call methods.
Design question: after a window closes itself inside its own scheduled work, later effects and timers go to the outer window. A test asserts this as intended. Architect to confirm or amend ADR-0015.
Nits from the r18 hunter: a nested close arbiter catches the outer window synchronous panics, a close that never settles leaves effects undisposed, the stack cell copies about 1 KB per access.
Round-14 leftovers: per-route latency samples, wheel logged before dispatch, a permanent test of UI take while a rebuild is held, nits, platform timing before the send.
Deep coordinates go to new entry P12 per architect decision D002. SCROLL only changes the ADR-0033 text and adds one depth test.

CONFIRMED by run 2026-11-26: P1 dispatch queues taken out whole (component.rs run_post, mailbox.rs run) - a close of window A by an earlier item cannot cancel A's later items, dropped in B's turn after A closed (got Some(true) want Some(false)). Repro kept at /tmp/m10/repro-clip-p1-confirmed.rs

r19 opus I1: dropping a live LayoutTree or Pipeline in a check disposes NodeInteraction flags in the forked arena (layout/mod.rs 631, interact.rs 562) and the flags stay alive live after the switch. Repro /tmp/m10/f1-opus-r19.md I1. Closed by ADR-0035 Owned routing.

r19 codex 1: LogCell::borrow lends a guard over the RefCell the engine drains and rolls back, mem::forget(guard) in a check breaks drain and rollback (engine/log_key.rs 182). Closed by closure-only borrows. Repro primitives/tests/repro_codexf19h.rs

r19 codex 2: chart snapshot lends shared Arc<Page> with public RwLock (chunk/series.rs 441, 238), a check writes page.data and live reads the check value. Closed by immutable lent data. Repro repro_codexf19h.rs

r19 codex 3: WorldRefCell checks world only when granting the borrow (world_cell.rs 199), a RefMut taken live and used in a check queues a live Close, a Ref returned from a check outlives the switch. Closed by closure-only borrows. Repro repro_codexf19h.rs
r19 codex 4: world identity is a thread-local serial (frame.rs 171, engine.rs 3553), a WorldCell moved between threads compares equal. Closed by process-global world id. Repro repro_codexf19h.rs

F1b (EM-granted, ADR-0035) edits in K4a paths: reactive/mod.rs deletes RenderNode::release (LiveDrop); reactive/runtime.rs Runtime::dispose refuses a live node's disposal inside a check (D3) + unit test; component.rs replaces Drop for Root and Drop for Leaving with Ending impls held in engine::Ends. Nothing else in those paths. Keep your version of any overlapping hunk; F1b adapts.

process_state fails on K4a's in-progress crates/gui/src/component/control.rs: Show.when/then/otherwise and Desc.items/key/view keep closures not listed in CLOSURES; NEXT_ROW advanced by hand (mint via engine::unique_id). Also clippy (lib test) on component/control/tests.rs:148,183,477.

Past FromRender::Failed each OwnFrames frame still sends ToRender::Commit to the dead render channel (window.rs RenderLink::commit, .ok() drops it) and never gets a Spare back, so every own frame builds and allocates a fresh Commit that is thrown away; link.feedback (held/drawn) also stays frozen at its last value (opus r16)

component.rs Life::end doc (around 'an explicit end ... a check makes ends the check's copy of the root') is stale after ADR-0035 D3: an explicit Root::close / Scope::dispose / window close of live nodes in a check now faults. Doc-only, left for K4a (F1b kept its component.rs edits to the two retiring wraps and RootEnd).

process_state CLOSURES needs 6 K4a entries; process_state.rs is claimed by F1b, so K4a cannot add them. Entries: 'crates/gui/src/component/control.rs | Show.when | a control node's source, run tracked by its node in the structure commit: pure (ADR-0026)'; '... | Show.then | a branch's view, run once per mount: pure, by the body rule'; '... | Show.otherwise | the same, the other branch'; '... | Desc.items | a control node's source: pure'; '... | Desc.key | a row's key of its item: pure'; '... | Desc.view | a row's view, run once per mount: pure, by the body rule'. Either release process_state.rs to K4a or F1b adds them.

Unkeyed siblings after an each/show take their layout path from their spliced position: inserting a row before them gives sibling A the NodePath sibling B had (identity and per-node state shift to the wrong node). Not documented in ADR-0026 or code; ADR's correspondence wants the static child position. Repro: div[each, A, B], insert row -> path(A) == old path(B).

window.rs ui_loop past terminal render failure: the own frame now runs only once the input queue is empty (try_recv drain). If input arrives faster than the UI handles it, own frames wait until the flood stops; a grant's FIFO position bounded that wait. Bound it (e.g. stamp the due time and drain only messages queued before it) if a workload shows it.

After terminal render failure a sustained input flood can delay own frames without bound (window.rs:617 drains until empty). Fix: drain only messages queued before the frame became due (count or stamp), then run the frame. Verified by Codex r18 (2a8306ec)

T3 runaway set-aside leaves live Ends un-ended: a live engine value (e.g. a LayoutTree) carried by a destructor that reschedules itself inside a check is quarantined at DRAIN_ROUNDS (engine/frame.rs teardown -> quarantine), so its Ending never runs live: 6 live flag signals leak per interactive node and the fault text says 'the live state is whole'. ADR-0035 T1 ('cleanup runs in the world that made it, or not at all if that world expired') needs a carve-out for set-aside values, or the fault text should say live ends were set aside. Repro (reviewer opusf1b1, run): push Carry(Some(live LayoutTree)) into a [Fresh] Vec whose Drop re-pushes itself inside testing::check -> Faulted(Runaway), signals ended 0 vs 6 for a live drop.
kept_closures fails on gui:app.rs Closing.root (F1b's closure, listed in process_state CLOSURES but not in kept_closures ALLOWED). K4a's six control.rs entries are added to kept_closures and pass.

Duplicate each() keys are reported once per node while they stay duplicated, kept in a bounded queue (64, oldest dropped) read by gui::take_duplicate_keys, with one eprintln per new report. Routing them into FrameReport (crates/gui/src/inspect.rs, filled in crates/gui/src/app.rs, F1b's claim) is left to the pipeline owner: add a duplicate_keys field filled from take_duplicate_keys each frame.

Adding a control node as a new child of an old-path parent switches unkeyed siblings from Index(i) to static keys, so a sibling before nothing changed path once (loses scroll, focus path, a11y id). Verified by Opus K4a r3. K4e identity work owns it.

K4b's in-progress attribute work (crates/gui/src/layout/attrs.rs Def.read and type HeldWrite, crates/gui/src/element.rs AttrOp) fails kept_closures::every_closure_kept_is_stored_or_said_why and process_state::every_kept_closure_is_reviewed / every_shared_handle_has_a_fork_policy; these block the joint K4a+F1b commit gate

Stress budget misses, pre-existing (fail identically on checkpoint e7c9e49 before F1b): scene toasts exceeds its allocation budget (2,102 vs 2,100) and the dashboard script fails a hit test. Not caused by ADR-0035; owner to root-cause both in stress (crates/shadcn stress, CI stress command).

layout/binding.rs Tracked::update_over (l.57-63): a binding whose first run panicked (memo None) or whose new closure panicked after a rebind (memo keeps the old Rc) reruns, and panics again, at every resolve of its node for any reason (an unrelated bound colour), contrary to its doc 'runs again when what it read before the panic changes'. Same for text_bound (pre-K4b) and bound attributes. Repro (opush K4b r2): text_bound(|| panic!()) + background(move || lit.get()); lit.set(true); settle panics again.

K4c built the windowed each (virtual_each) with rows placed as today: a flex column whose scroll offset is local to the window's first row. ADR-0026's sticky placement origin (f32 from an origin row, re-base past 2^16 px, one-sided shared range offset on measurement) is not built, so a window shift still moves the remaining rows' content y (the scroll offset compensates) and layout still visits the column's rows. Structural side is met (only rows in/out mount/dispose, 0 moves, kept rows run no view or binding, identical counts at 10k and 10M). Needs a decision: K4c follow-up round or fold into K5/L2 with the frame-side counters (child slots changed, parents updated, siblings visited).

Callers still use the render-path virtual_list/virtual_list_in: shadcn table.rs:72, command.rs:403, message_scroller.rs:1043, stress scenes.rs:520, primitives tree.rs:604, scroll_area.rs:512, listbox (via callers). They move to virtual_each/virtual_each_in with their families (SLICE for select/listbox, S8 otherwise); virtual_list and the render-time plan (version signal, Plan in track_scroll_built) are deleted at K8.

tests/dispatch_kinds.rs catching_lives_in_the_engine fails on the working tree: catches/raises outside the engine counted in access/bound.rs (9, unlisted) and component.rs (2, list says 1). Not from K4c (list/* only); appears with K4b's uncommitted access/bound.rs changes.

On a node's first mount, bind_flags writes disabled=false then true in the same resolve (patch.rs resolve_own); sources registered on that handle's disabled flag may wake one extra time. Harmless for cold parity.
